authority: CEO Round 120 deep audit — 5 P0 corrections required before experiment execution

governance_compliance.article_I: No circular reasoning (raw observable, not model-derived D)
governance_compliance.article_XXXIV: FINAL protocol amendment. Then STOP and run experiment.
governance_compliance.rule_6: Primary evidence = raw force/displacement, NOT model-inferred D
governance_compliance.rule_15: No silent promotion — Stage-0 pilot, not validation
governance_compliance.rule_9: Statistical analysis preregistered before data collection

P0_1_remove_model_circularity.problem: Original used D = 1 - sigma_measured/sigma_undamaged (requires counterfactual). Circular: model -> inferred D -> derivative -> 'validation of model.'
P0_1_remove_model_circularity.correction: Replace with RAW force/displacement observables that do NOT require estimating sigma_undamaged.

new_primary_observables.name: Force curvature (d2F/ddelta2)
new_primary_observables.definition: Second derivative of measured force F w.r.t. measured displacement delta
new_primary_observables.rationale: dD/dstrain deceleration in simulation corresponds to force curve transitioning from concave-up (stiffening) to concave-down (softening). Raw observable = force CURVATURE sign change. No model needed.
new_primary_observables.signal_criterion: d2F/ddelta2 changes sign from positive to negative BEFORE visible fragmentation

new_primary_observables.name: Secant stiffness degradation rate (dK/ddelta)
new_primary_observables.definition: K = F/delta; dK/ddelta = rate of stiffness change
new_primary_observables.rationale: As damage accumulates, stiffness decreases. The RATE of decrease changes before fracture. Raw observable.
new_primary_observables.signal_criterion: dK/ddelta transitions from steep negative to shallow negative BEFORE fragmentation

new_primary_observables.name: Force derivative peak (dF/ddelta peak)
new_primary_observables.definition: Peak of first derivative of force w.r.t. displacement
new_primary_observables.rationale: Force curve has maximum slope before softening begins. Raw analog of dD/dstrain peak.
new_primary_observables.signal_criterion: dF/ddelta reaches peak and decreases BEFORE visible fragmentation

P0_1_remove_model_circularity.anti_circularity_principle: REAL MEASUREMENT (force, displacement) -> raw signal -> fragmentation. Model NOT in measurement pipeline. Model only PREDICTS the raw signal shape.

P0_2_freeze_strain_rate.displacement_rate: 0.1 mm/s for 10mm clot (computed from strain rate x initial length)
P0_2_freeze_strain_rate.both_reported: Lead strain AND lead time (seconds) reported for every sample. No post-hoc selection.

P0_3_relabel_stage_0_pilot.new_title: Stage-0 Falsification Pilot: Raw Force/Displacement Precursor to Clot Fragmentation
P0_3_relabel_stage_0_pilot.objective: Determine whether a raw force/displacement precursor to fragmentation exists AT ALL
P0_3_relabel_stage_0_pilot.interpretation: Positive = precursor exists ex-vivo. NOT = thrombectomy invention proven.

P0_4_preregistered_statistics.primary_endpoint: Force curvature sign change (d2F/ddelta2: + -> -) BEFORE fragmentation (camera ground truth)
P0_4_preregistered_statistics.unit_of_analysis: Individual clot sample (n=10 per group, 20 total)
P0_4_preregistered_statistics.success_criterion: >=7/10 samples in at least one measured-composition group show signal
P0_4_preregistered_statistics.false_positive: P(>=7/10 | p=0.5) = 0.17 (not significant). P(>=7/10 | p=0.9) = 0.93. Screening threshold, not validation.
P0_4_preregistered_statistics.composition_stratification: Two groups by MEASURED composition: RBC-rich (>60%) and fibrin-rich (<30%). Results reported per group.
P0_4_preregistered_statistics.exclusion_rules: No fragmentation within 50% strain = excluded (recorded as 'no fragmentation'). >3/10 excluded = group 'inconclusive'. Sensor failure = excluded with reason.
P0_4_preregistered_statistics.multiple_testing: 3 raw observables tested. Primary = force curvature (hierarchy). Others secondary. Bonferroni noted but not applied (pilot).

P0_5_composition_verification.method: Post-test histology: formalin fixation, H&E + MSB staining, image analysis for RBC/fibrin area fractions
P0_5_composition_verification.analysis: Subgroup by MEASURED composition, not recipe. Per Rule 6: measured = primary evidence.

final_protocol_summary.title: Stage-0 Falsification Pilot: Raw Force/Displacement Precursor to Clot Fragmentation
final_protocol_summary.primary_signal: Force curvature sign change BEFORE fragmentation
final_protocol_summary.interpretation: Stage-0 pilot. Positive = precursor exists ex-vivo. NOT = invention proven.
final_protocol_summary.model_role: Simulation PREDICTS raw signal shape. Raw signal is ground truth. No model in pipeline.

then_stop: Per CEO: 'No more computational refinement. Run the physical experiment.' This IS the final amendment. Next step = PHYSICAL EXECUTION.
